gaps.sentence: I wish you ___ so pessimistic about the project.
gaps.hint: a wish about a present attitude
gaps.explanation: Wishes about present states use 'were': were not.

gaps.sentence: I will note the reference number in case I ___ it later.
gaps.hint: in case means as a precaution
gaps.explanation: 'In case' describes a precaution and takes the present simple: need.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: He would be healthier if he ___ so much red meat.
gaps.hint: an unreal present habit, past simple
gaps.explanation: For an unreal present habit, the if-clause uses the past simple: did not eat.

gaps.sentence: You may keep the book provided that you ___ it by Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided that' introduces a condition in the present simple: return.

gaps.sentence: If people ___ less time on their phones, they would read more.
gaps.explanation: An unreal present habit takes the past simple in the if-clause: spent.

gaps.sentence: What ___ if the bridge had collapsed?
gaps.hint: a question about an unreal past
gaps.explanation: Questions about unreal pasts use 'would have' plus the participle: would have happened.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ me, I would have helped you move house.
gaps.hint: a missed request in the past
gaps.explanation: An unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had asked.
